body:
Compiler bootstrap memory continues to interrupt focused application-efficiency work on the shared machine. The #841 same-source/profile raw/gzip fixture pair completed, but gzip had worse observed peak group RSS (5,930,647,552 vs 5,249,531,904 bytes), despite a 4,738,944-byte smaller executable. Order, page cache and ambient memory were uncontrolled; this is not causal evidence that runtime loading will help. #841's compressed default is being rejected. Broader #798 remains open.

Investigate a bounded test-only alternative: load a large immutable historical evidence fixture at test runtime instead of embedding it with include_str!/include_bytes!. Start with the existing 5,196,870-byte selected-child-refusal-781/exact-source-inverses.json, whose original SHA256 is 2ff3e371c8bfde876ede4f5e7445a26067858e4a0d84610cca94d5b3ccc1240e. The raw historical bytes and every original assertion remain authoritative. This is a source-only candidate, not a RAM, application-cap or token saving.

Acceptance:
- One explicit repository fixture path, one opened regular-file handle; validate exact length and hard cap before buffer acquisition, read exactly the admitted bytes plus an EOF check, authenticate the compiled immutable SHA256 and UTF-8 before the existing complete JSON/source assertions. Fail closed on missing, truncated, extra or tampered input. No unbounded fixture discovery or global cache.
- Keep the immutable fixture, every complete inverse/source/hostile-input assertion, all independent compiled old receivers, original owner discovery/counts and all source audit coverage. Load outside allocation/budget probes. No production exports, authorities, behavior, diagnostics, caps or fee changes.
- State the new test-runtime filesystem dependency honestly: the binary requires its repository fixture and is no longer self-contained for this owner. No build-time network or external decoding process.
- Preserve full current-to-old source reconstruction. Run only the exact owning test and the loader's bounded success/refusal controls; no full suites or quality gates.
- Compare a fresh matched same-source/profile no-run build pair when host resources permit. Preserve one-worker safeguards/private SSD targets, identify the observed phase where possible, report wall time, group peak RSS, artifact size and all pressure refusals/order/cache limitations. Keep only for a meaningful measured benefit; no repeated pair fishing.
- Report bootstrap/setup separately from live-agent application tokens, turns and accepted-task costs. Do not claim an application or token advantage from fixture-byte or binary-size reduction alone.

Review found no inherent invariant blocker in this approach. No implementation or matched build has run for this proposal. Coordinate with #798; do not reopen or overwrite the historical #841 experiment.
title: (OPT) Load authenticated immutable test evidence at runtime to reduce embedded compiler constants
